acknowledgements.reason: Necessary to reach DONE: six host-launcher session env keys (CLAUDE_PID, CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET/TOKEN, CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION, CODEX_COMPANION_SESSION_ID/TRANSCRIPT_PATH) were hashed into effectiveEnvironmentDigest, so any DONE-required receipt written in one session could never be re-derived in another and this story's own passing validation kept reading as effective-environment-digest-mismatch. Stripped at the filter so the digest-pinned VALIDATION_TRANSPORT_ENV_KEY_LIST stays byte-stable (pin verified unchanged); the smoke file adds the per-key digest-neutrality regression, verified to fail when the strip is removed.

Framework-written dev-memory runtime log, not story-authored content. The CLI appends to .proof-or-stop/dev-memory/experience.jsonl on its own during normal command execution, and it was swept into this story's lifecycle-metadata commit alongside the dev_memory_finish_decision record that the DONE gate requires. It carries no implementation change for B-0b50; the file is an append-only observability log written by the runtime itself.
